description: Search tracked US job listings by keyword, company, status, location and posting age. Returns compact summaries with paging; use jobslop_get_job for one listing's full detail.

location.description: Text the location must contain, e.g. "Remote", "Austin" or "NY".

offset.description: Results to skip, for paging. Use next_offset from the previous page.

posted_within_days.description: Only listings posted (or first seen) within this many days.

query.description: Words that must all appear in the title, company, location or source, e.g. "senior data engineer".

sort.description: newest/oldest by posting age; most_reposted by repost count; recently_seen by last sighting.

status.description: ghost = flagged listings; active = open and not flagged; inactive = no longer seen on its source and not flagged.

name: jobslop_search_jobs
title: Search JobSlop listings
